summary: Scope is clean: every 0.3.0 milestone and every owner decision I traced is implemented and has a test or evidence file, and nothing out of scope slipped in (no production fetch/XHR/WebSocket/beacon; the only network use is the speech model download, and the roster assistant path adds none; no sync, Auth, backend, native or generic content system). The 2026-10-06 owner decisions (deployed app is 0.3.0; iPhone checks and GitHub Support to future work) are recorded consistently in QUESTIONS, NEXT_STEPS and physical-device-review.json, and no document claims a physical iPhone check. Version 0.3.0 is in package.json, package-lock.json (both entries) and pinned by scripts/check-repository.mjs; the plan status table agrees with the manifest (UG2 IN_PROGRESS, everything else COMPLETE, every required evidence file of the completed milestones exists). Two blockers remain: one false changelog claim (dictation is faster) and four stress-profile layout findings left as test.fixme under an 'owner design decision' the owner never recorded (a fix is under way elsewhere; my review is of 40b55c1 and that fix is not in it). The rest are known-limitation gaps in CHANGELOG.md and authoritative documents that still require what the owner deferred.

recheck.summary: Both blockers are resolved at 1ec3e6c. UG2-SCO-1: the changelog's dictation sentence is now true (no confirm step; speed and accuracy unchanged), verified against the speech code and the V03 evidence. Of the QoL findings 10, 11, 12 and 15 are resolved, 16 is partial, 13 and 14 are open. The verdict is PASS_WITH_FINDINGS.

resolvedBlockers.title: The 0.3.0 changelog says dictation is faster; the measured evidence says it is not
resolvedBlockers.evidence: CHANGELOG.md:41-42 ('Dictation is faster and no longer asks to confirm the transcript'). Contradicted by .evidence/V03/speech-quality-benchmark.json (status COMPLETE_NO_WINNER; production whisper-base q8 retained at 53.8% WER and 5,308 ms median warm latency; decision 'No candidate meets the acceptance rule'), .evidence/V03/speech-review.json:9 (the owner's acceptance 'is not evidence of a latency or accuracy improvement') and 04_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md V03 'Progress, 2026-09-24'. git diff v0.2.0..HEAD -- src/capabilities/speech.ts changes the model revision pin, the ONNX runtime origin and chunking above 30 s, not the model or its speed.
resolvedBlockers.impact: A false release claim about the one feature the owner called slow and imprecise, on a document the owner asked to be adversarially checked for exactly this (OWNER_BRIEF 1.3).
resolvedBlockers.suggestedFix: Reword to what is true: 'Dictation no longer asks to confirm the transcript: the text goes straight into the note. Its speed and accuracy are unchanged; it is still slow and imprecise.' Optionally add that the speech runtime now loads from the app's own origin and the model is pinned.

recheck.evidence: CHANGELOG.md (0.3.0, Dictation bullet) now says 'Dictation no longer asks to confirm the transcript. Its speed and accuracy are unchanged: it is still slow and imprecise, and stays as it is for now.' Checked against the code and evidence: git diff v0.2.0..HEAD -- src/capabilities/speech.ts changes only the revision pin (the sha the S4 benchmark measured), the ONNX runtime origin and chunking above 30 s, and keeps whisper-base q8 with the same TRANSCRIPTION_GUARD; src/features/speech/dictationState.ts no longer has the 'review' status in isDictationPending, so the 'no confirm step' half is true; .evidence/V03/speech-quality-benchmark.json and speech-review.json agree that nothing became faster or more accurate. importantFindings.title: Known limitations omit that the course exists only on the phone, and recommend reinstalling
importantFindings.evidence: CHANGELOG.md:62-63 ('uninstalling and reinstalling is more reliable') and 43-44 (erase). No limitation says there is no export or backup: 0_3_0_DEVELOPMENT_AUDIT.md:18 ('Clearing browser data or changing phones can lose courses ... no user-facing restore route was found'), 1_0_0_NEXT_STEPS.md:33 (export/import is 0.4.0 work). 0_3_0_QUESTIONS.md:125-130 and 49 (erase may leave deleted rows in unused database pages on a browser that cannot compact; clearing the site's data is the strongest wipe; a full local reset is future work) and src/persistence/courses.ts:82-89 (VACUUM is best-effort).
importantFindings.impact: An instructor following the changelog's own workaround can delete the only copy of a week's students, notes and evaluations (minors' data); and 'Impostazioni can erase the course' reads as a guaranteed wipe. This is exactly the kind of limitation the changelog is supposed to state.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Add: 'The course lives only on this phone. There is no export or backup yet; clearing the browser's data or uninstalling the app may delete it. Reinstall only when the course is no longer needed.' and 'Erasing the course removes its rows but on some browsers they may remain in unused storage pages until reused; clear the site's data for a guaranteed wipe.'

recheck.evidence: CHANGELOG.md Known limitations now opens with 'The course lives only on this phone. There is no export or backup yet. Uninstalling the app or clearing the browser's data can delete the course, so do not reinstall to update in the middle of a course. Erasing the course deletes its rows and compacts the database where the browser allows, but it is not a guaranteed wipe on every browser.' and the Updating bullet says reinstalling 'without a backup, risks the course data'. This matches src/persistence/courses.ts (VACUUM inside try/catch, best effort). Not in the changelog (recorded only in .evidence/UG2/data-integrity-review.json and, for the OCR worker, 1_0_0_NEXT_STEPS.md): the clipboard image a Copia immagine leaves and the OCR worker holding the last roster image in memory after an erase (UG2-DAT-8, UG2-DAT-11).
